event.title: Ice and rock collapse on the Tibet–Nepal border
event.place: Ice and rock collapse on the Tibet–Nepal border · Gyirong–Rasuwa
event.lede: On 26 August 2026 rock and ice broke off Langtang Lirung and a debris-laden flood swept down the border valley into Nepal.
facts: Collapse at about 8:37 am Nepal time on the northern flank of the Langtang Lirung massif (ICIMOD).
The flood reached Betrawati at about 9:20 am (ICIMOD).

maturity.text: This page uses Copernicus Sentinel-2 true-colour images made here and images and maps published by ESA and UNOSAT; it does not include a NISAR analysis.

simple.title: Ice and rock collapse on the Tibet–Nepal border

finding.text: UNOSAT data of 2 September 2026: in its whole analysis area of about 1,246 km² (Rasuwa and Nuwakot districts), about 65 km² appears to be affected by the flood; about 2.3 km² of that lies in this image.
